sources.title: Randomized Ensembled Double Q-Learning: Learning Fast Without a Model
sources.verified_idea: Repeated critic updates, a critic ensemble and a minimum over a random subset of target critics.
sources.implementation_difference: This project uses a deterministic actor with Gaussian practice noise, four critics and four updates, not an exact REDQ implementation.

sources.title: Efficient Online Reinforcement Learning with Offline Data
sources.verified_idea: Symmetric replay sampling, layer normalization and critic ensembles are part of its design study.
sources.implementation_difference: Here fill-up data are newly collected and fully charged to each 200-episode budget; no historical offline dataset is free.
